title: Design That Reaches Production
subtitle: Hands-on experience design for a consumer app, and a team moved onto AI-assisted work

cv.label: Download CV (PDF)
cv.note: Tailored for the Director Experience Design role at adidas

bio.short: I lead design and still do it myself, from insight to production code. As Head of Product Design at Bibel TV, I shaped a consumer streaming app across iOS, Android, web and TV. I also moved the product team onto AI-assisted design and building. Before that, I led design teams at Ninox and Datameer.
bio.long:
At Bibel TV, a broadcaster moving from linear TV to apps on iOS, Android, web and connected TV, I was Head of Product Design. I owned product design for the app end to end and prototyped in real code. 64% of the code behind the redesigned Android Home and detail views comes verbatim from my prototype (release 6.0, in beta). Small changes moved numbers: when I made the app's AI Bible feature self-explaining, weekly starts rose 153% on iOS and 85% on Android.

I also changed how the product team works. We went from AI as a better search tool to prototyping and developing with Claude Code, GitHub Spec Kit and MCP servers. I got there with tutorials and hands-on sessions, not mandates, and the team now builds internal tools in-house.

Before that I led design teams. At Ninox I had five direct reports on the Senior Leadership Team and promoted two. At Datameer I led the UX team across Germany and New York for five years. And I run a few times a week, so a running app is a product I use.

context.company: adidas Digital runs the adidas Running App, one of adidas' key digital experiences for runners.
context.role: Director Experience Design: a hands-on player-coach who owns the app experience against WAU, engagement, retention and NPS. Coaches a small design team and pioneers AI-enabled design practice for the wider design community.
context.emphasis: Lead with craft that reaches production code and AI-assisted practice the team adopted; the AI Bible feature lift as consumer proof; team leadership second.

work_intro: Selected work where the design went all the way to working code, and changed how the team builds
